name: Acceptance and Commitment Therapy for chronic pain (ACT)

indicators.metric: RCTs of ACT for chronic pain in largest meta-analysis
indicators.source: Lai et al. 2023 Behav Res Ther

indicators.value: NICE NG193 rec 1.2.3: consider ACT or CBT for chronic primary pain
Stanza De Novo DEN220083 (9 May 2023), first for fibromyalgia symptoms

reach_estimate: Roughly 10^5.5-10^6 people with chronic pain have received ACT for pain cumulatively. This is an order-of-magnitude guess based on several thousand trial participants, ~20 years of routine use in NHS and US VA/academic pain services, internet programmes, Stanza users and self-help book sales. ACT across all conditions reaches far more people.

name: Alexander Technique

indicators.value: founded 1958; self-described oldest/largest society (not independently verified)
ATEAM BMJ 2008 (N=579); ATLAS Ann Intern Med 2015 (N=517)

indicators.metric: PubMed records with 'Alexander technique' in title/abstract plus trial/review terms

reach_estimate: Roughly a few million people cumulatively over about 120 years (order of magnitude). Thousands of teachers worldwide, each teaching hundreds of pupils over a career, plus mass performing-arts curricula and book readership.

name: ANS REWIRE

indicators.value: March 2016 (as reported by researcher; Wayback not re-checkable at fact-check)
Health Rising recovery story published Aug 25 2015
Ongoing Dan Neuffer podcast; guest on Long Covid Podcast

reach_estimate: Roughly 10^4 people. Paid participants are probably in the low thousands to about 10k; book, podcast and blog audiences perhaps several tens of thousands.

name: Association for the Treatment of Neuroplastic Symptoms (ATNS; formerly Psychophysiologic Disorders Association, PPDA)
category: psychological/neuroplastic-pain therapy (nonprofit education, referral and advocacy hub)

indicators.value: ~250 practitioners from 11 states and 4 countries (NY Academy of Medicine); archived page, not re-verified
$65k goal reached 144%; ~500 international donors (Boulder PRT trial); archived page, not re-verified. PPDA funding confirmed in JAMA Psychiatry 2022 acknowledgments
~30,000 people/month via site, emails and community (self-reported)
155 listings: 131 licensed practitioners + 24 recovery coaches; ~13 countries; 49 accept insurance
Toronto, Rochester NY, NYC, Colorado, Oregon, Wisconsin, Michigan, Texas
Clarke: 300+ TV/radio/podcast interviews; executive producer of 3 documentaries (All The Rage 2016, This Might Hurt 2018, Pain Brain 2023)
40+ sessions, up to 17.75 CE/CME hours, in person in Dallas, Oct 15-17 2026

indicators.metric: Claimed patients treated by board clinicians

reach_estimate: About 300k-1M cumulative people reached. Basis: ~30k/month self-reported current reach (~360k/yr), lower in earlier years; thousands of conference, course and membership participants; >10k patients treated by board clinicians. Deep engagement (members, course takers, attendees) is probably in the low tens of thousands.

name: Back in Control / The DOC Journey (David Hanscom)

indicators.metric: Book: Back in Control 1st edition (Vertus Press)

indicators.value: published (PT bio says 2016; OpenLibrary lists 2014/2017 printings)

indicators.metric: Omega Institute chronic pain workshop faculty
Book: Do You Really Need Spine Surgery?
Calm Your Body, Heal Your Mind
indicators.value: newest book (dated 2026 on PT bio; release year not independently confirmed)

reach_estimate: About 10^4.5 (roughly 30,000). Basis: book readership for two editions and two later books, likely tens of thousands; patients seen clinically, >1,000 claimed; DOC subscribers inferred at hundreds to low thousands; plus podcast/blog audience. No official counts.

name: Breathworks Mindfulness-Based Pain Management (MBPM) / Mindfulness for Health

indicators.value: Mindfulness for Health (Burch & Penman 2013) won first prize for Popular Medicine at the BMA Book Awards (per Breathworks; year not independently verified)
Mindfulness for Health listed on the Reading Well scheme (per Breathworks)
Vidyamala Burch OBE (2022 Birthday Honours) for services to wellbeing and pain management
6 records match 'Breathworks'; about 7 match 'mindfulness-based pain management' (some not Breathworks)
239 patients in the Jersey pain service; 41% had ≥30% pain-intensity reduction; 84% completion
indicators.source: Agostinis et al. 2022 Pain News (as summarised by Breathworks)

reach_estimate: ~100,000-300,000. Breathworks self-reports 100k+ via courses and teachers. Book readership is likely in the tens to low hundreds of thousands across translations (not verified).

name: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Chronic Pain (CBT-CP), incl. VA national CBT-CP program

indicators.metric: RCTs of CBT in Cochrane review
indicators.value: 59 CBT trials (>5,000 participants); 75 psychological trials, 9,401 participants overall

indicators.metric: VA patients treated in training program
VA pain patients seen by CBT-CP-trained therapists

indicators.source: Stewart et al. Clin J Pain 2015

reach_estimate: About 1 million cumulative worldwide receiving CBT-based pain treatment, including multidisciplinary pain programmes (UK, Europe, US, Australia); VHA CBT-CP alone likely tens of thousands (>=14,000 implied by 38.4% of 37,514 in 2015-2020). Order-of-magnitude estimate, not measured.

name: CBT and Graded Exercise Therapy for CFS/ME (PACE-trial model; KCL/Chalder and Nijmegen/Knoop CBT for fatigue)

indicators.value: PACE n=641, Lancet 2011, heavy UK media coverage
NICE CG53 recommended CBT/GET as first-line
NICE NG206: do not offer GET; CBT supportive only
CBT/GET removed from CDC ME/CFS pages
Tuller 'Trial By Error' (Virology Blog), ~15,000-word 2015 exposé plus many follow-up posts
First-Tier Tribunal ordered QMUL to release PACE data
ReCOVer RCT n=114, Clin Infect Dis
n=1,298 pooled from 8 RCTs of the Dutch CBT protocol

reach_estimate: ~100k-300k patients treated directly with CBT/GET for CFS (order-of-magnitude only). The basis is an unverified estimate of ~8-10k new UK specialist-service patients a year for ~15 years, plus the Dutch centres and a few thousand trial participants. Indirect reach through GP advice and guidelines is far larger.

name: The Center for Mind-Body Medicine (CMBM) model / Mind-Body Skills Groups
category: contemplative/meditation program (group mind-body skills; train-the-trainer nonprofit)

indicators.value: ~1,500 local trainees since 2005; >280,000 children and adults reached
indicators.source: cmbm.org How We Started / Gaza impact story
Staples & Gordon 2005, Altern Ther Health Med

indicators.value: ~15 US medical schools with CMBM-trained faculty
target >500,000 people in Gaza over 3 years (est. USD 6M)

reach_estimate: About 8,000 professionals trained directly. Trainees have reached roughly several hundred thousand people by CMBM's own unverified counts (Gaza >280,000; Haiti >60,000; plus US schools, VA and medical schools). Order of 4e5-6e5 cumulative.

name: CFS Health (Online Recovery Program / RECOVERY Mentorship 3.0)

indicators.value: ~45.1K subscribers, ~1,164 videos, ~5.48M total views; channel created Sep 2011
Get Your Life Back (Dean Publishing, 15 Apr 2026; narrated by Morrison)

reach_estimate: Roughly 5,000-10,000 paying members cumulatively (vendor claim 5,500+). Free-content reach is about 10^5-10^6 (5.5M YouTube views). Cumulative people meaningfully reached is estimated at about 50K-100K.

name: CFS Recovery (Recovery School / Recovery Academy / Recovery Platinum)
reach_estimate: About 2,000-3,000 paying clients (company claim of 2,000+), plus perhaps tens of thousands of YouTube viewers. Core reach is about 10^3.4.

name: Cognitive Functional Therapy (CFT)

indicators.metric: PubMed items with 'cognitive functional therapy' in title/abstract (cumulative)
Lancet RESTORE publication with editorial and international press
3-year RESTORE results with press coverage and a JAMA news item
Certified CFT trainers listed by Evoolve
indicators.value: 17 listings (16 people): Australia 7, Brazil 1, Norway 1, Belgium 1, Denmark 3, Ireland 1, UK 4
Latvia, Switzerland, Germany, Netherlands, Adelaide, plus masterclasses

reach_estimate: About 50,000 people cumulatively, as an order of magnitude. Trial participants total roughly 1,700. Thousands of physiotherapists have likely been exposed through workshops and the online course. Clinical delivery in Australia, Scandinavia, Ireland, the UK and Brazil over about 15 years plausibly reaches tens of thousands of patients. No counts of clinicians trained or patients treated have been published.

name: Compassionate Inquiry (Gabor Maté)

indicators.metric: Book: In the Realm of Hungry Ghosts
Book: When the Body Says No

indicators.value: Prince Harry livestream interview (March 2023, global coverage)
0 (PubMed 'compassionate inquiry' = 7 unrelated hits; Europe PMC; ClinicalTrials.gov)

reach_estimate: Direct CI reach is probably ~10^4 (thousands of trainees plus their clients). Maté's broader framework has reached ~10^7 (self-reported 10M+ film viewers, millions of book readers and podcast listeners). Weighted estimate is ~10^6.5 people exposed to the CI/Maté model.

name: Curable (app)

indicators.metric: Podcast Like Mind, Like Body episodes

indicators.value: Thomson 2024; Melzack Paper of the Year 2024 (announced 2025)

reach_estimate: ~1 million cumulative users (company claim of 1M+ in 2026, likely including free and trial users). Paid subscribers are probably 10^4 to 10^5 (rough guess).

name: DARE (Barry McDonagh) and the Claire Weekes method

indicators.metric: Self Help for Your Nerves copies sold
indicators.value: 400,000+ by 1978 (ADB; Wikipedia says 300,000+), translated into 14 languages, in print since 1962
1M and 1.8M both appear on the site; counter shows '145.315 people helped'
Hoare, The Woman Who Cracked the Anxiety Code (Scribe 2019); ADAA 40th-anniversary tribute 2020

reach_estimate: About 1-3 million cumulative. Weekes's books plausibly reached hundreds of thousands to low millions of readers over 60 years (400k+ copies of her first book by 1978 alone). DARE adds 400k+ book buyers and 1M+ app downloads, of which perhaps several hundred thousand were active users.

name: Dynamic Neural Retraining System (DNRS)

indicators.metric: Wired for Healing copies sold (company claim)
Patients referred by a single endorsing physician (Neil Nathan)

reach_estimate: ~30k-100k cumulative participants (tens of thousands of course purchasers, plus 65k+ book buyers, some overlapping). The site claims it has 'helped thousands'.

name: EFT Tapping (Emotional Freedom Techniques) / The Tapping Solution

indicators.value: 32M+ (home page); the app page still says 17M+ meditations played
The Tapping Solution (2013) and Jessica Ortner's weight-loss book (2014) described as NYT bestsellers; Pain Relief book 2015
NeuroTap Health, Inc. listed as an ACCESS Model participant (MSK, BH tracks); the model began 5 Jul 2026

reach_estimate: About 5-10 million people cumulatively. The Tapping Solution claims 4M+ (with 868k unique users who rated sessions in the app); on top of that are 1990s-2000s users of Craig's free EFT manual and emofree.com, readers of Mercola's promotion, and Clinical EFT practitioners' clients worldwide.

name: EMDR (Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing)

indicators.value: more than 15,000 (elsewhere on the same page, 20,000+)
millions (emdr.com, 'over the past 33 years'); EMDRIA: 'millions of people across 130 countries'

indicators.metric: PubMed records (EMDR in title/abstract) per year

indicators.value: Prince Harry on-camera EMDR session, The Me You Can't See (Apple TV+)
Shapiro textbook 1995/2001/2018; Getting Past Your Past 2012; featured in van der Kolk's The Body Keeps the Score 2014

reach_estimate: About 5 million cumulative clients (order of magnitude). Basis: organisational claims of more than 100,000 trained clinicians and 'millions' treated, plus routine PTSD use in NHS, VA and European services. Pain-specific reach is far smaller, probably tens of thousands.

name: Emotional Awareness and Expression Therapy (EAET)

indicators.metric: PubMed records with exact phrase 'emotional awareness and expression therapy'
Randomized trials published (EAET or close variants)
indicators.value: about 9 RCTs plus 2 precursor RCTs and about 5 uncontrolled studies. Registered ongoing trials: NCT06044649 (N=408), NCT06004804 (target 216), NCT07218757 (target 672).
Listed as a behavioral treatment option in the HHS Pain Management Best Practices Task Force report (p. 38)
NPR Shots feature on a fibromyalgia patient treated with EAET

indicators.metric: Media spike after JAMA Netw Open trial
indicators.value: Covered by UCLA Health, ScienceDaily, HealthDay, McKnight's and MDedge ('new psychotherapeutic gold standard')
USD 600 Zoom course; waitlist only; next cohort dates given inconsistently (autumn 2026 vs early 2027)
No dedicated subreddit or app; only incidental mentions in PRT/Sarno communities

reach_estimate: About 10^4 people. Trial participants total about 1,500. Several hundred to low thousands of clinicians have been trained, each treating a few to dozens of patients. VA and academic clinics add to this. Readers of Schubiner's books (likely tens of thousands) were not counted as EAET recipients.

empoweredrelief.com first archived Jul 2019; Stanford site Aug 2020

reach_estimate: ~10,000-30,000 cumulative patients: 10,000+ reported by the program, plus trial participants and unreported classes at adopting health systems (order of magnitude 10^4)

International syndication of 2022 RCT (AFP, Smithsonian, NewsNation); 2026 press spike (Imperial, EMJ, OperaWire)

Widely viewed lay talk (view count not verified)

reach_estimate: ~1-5 million people. Basis: decades of PNE delivery in physio practice worldwide (tens of thousands of trained clinicians), book sales, 180k Flippin' Pain, 20k Pain Revolution, plus video audiences. Excludes indirect exposure via apps. Rough estimate.

name: Feldenkrais Method (Awareness Through Movement / Functional Integration)

Awareness Through Movement (1972) in print for 50+ years

reach_estimate: About 1 million cumulative (order of magnitude). Basis: a few thousand certified practitioners worldwide (1,287 in the US in 2014), most part-time and seeing fewer than 10 individual plus fewer than 10 group students a week, over 50+ years, plus book readers and free online ATM audiences.

name: FibroGuide / PainGuide (University of Michigan CPFRC)
category: digital app/platform (academic, free web-based CBT self-management)

indicators.value: BEST trial: 1,014-1,019 enrolled / 805 randomized (205 to PainGuide self-care)

name: Gupta Program (Amygdala and Insula Retraining, AIR)

Long-COVID RCT press coverage (HealthDay, Newswise) July 2023; Integrative Medicine interviews 2021, 2022, 2024

name: Hanna Somatic Education / Clinical Somatics (incl. Somatic Movement Center, Essential Somatics)
reach_estimate: ~10^5.5 (~300k) people. Basis: a few hundred practitioners each seeing hundreds of clients over 50 years; a book in print since 1988 (likely ~100k+ copies, unverified); SMC and Essential Somatics online courses with thousands to tens of thousands of enrollees (a 2,268-respondent survey of completers implies a far larger enrolled base); ~100k YouTube subscribers across the two channels, with likely millions of video views. Excludes the wider generic 'somatic exercise' social-media audience. Coarse; not independently verified.

name: HeartMath (HRV coherence biofeedback: Inner Balance, emWave)

indicators.value: Freeze-Framer 1999; emWave PSR 2006; emWave PC 2007; Inner Balance 2013 + emWave Pro; emWave Pro Plus 2015; Global Coherence app 2021; new HeartMath app 2023-25
indicators.source: McCraty 2022 Appl Psychophysiol Biofeedback; App Store

reach_estimate: Roughly 10^6 people cumulatively. The company claims millions of users across devices, apps, books, workplace, school and hospital programs over 35 years, and 12K certified practitioners. The App Store rating count (~4.7K) suggests active app users in the low hundreds of thousands at most.

name: Interdisciplinary pain rehabilitation / functional restoration (Mayo Clinic Pain Rehabilitation Center and similar)
delivery: intensive outpatient day program (3 weeks, ~8 h/day; pediatric 17 days)

indicators.metric: Mayo Rochester adult PRC annual patients

Murphy et al., Pain Med 2021 (IASP-linked summary)

reach_estimate: Mayo PRCs alone: ~300+/yr in Rochester for ~50 years, plus Florida, Arizona and pediatric programs, giving roughly 20,000-30,000 cumulative patients (log10 ~4.4). The generic interdisciplinary/multimodal model (US peak era, VA, Germany, Scandinavia, pediatric IIPT) has plausibly reached on the order of 1 million people worldwide (log10 ~6); this broader figure is used here but is a rough, unverified extrapolation.

name: Internal Family Systems (IFS)

No Bad Parts (Sounds True, 2021), bestseller with an audiobook featuring Alanis Morissette
full-time staff grew from 12 to 35; trainers from 30 to more than 100

reach_estimate: Several million people. Tens of thousands of trained clinicians (nearly 4,000 per year recently, plus 45k Psychology Today profiles) each see many clients, and books, podcasts and social media reach millions more. Estimate: roughly 1-5 million people have received IFS or IFS-informed therapy or self-help.

Basis: 500+ certified teachers and probably several thousand Level 1 trainees, each teaching groups over years; many VA facility classes; free audios and books; Australian/Canadian use. Audiences for generic 'yoga nidra'/NSDR (millions) are excluded because that material is not iRest-branded.
